question.problem:
Solve the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}1.4x+2.8y=1.4 \\ 0.02x+0.01y=0.05\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To get rid of the decimals, we multiply the first equation by $10$ and the second equation by $100,$ as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14221949/assets/5e8fbe9a6109fb1b4046645e38993449229ff9ea0d4634a22d98e65a38786c2f.svg)

To simplify the first equation, we divide by $14\mathbin{:}$
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14221949/assets/f673f4aa7086390409fef5d20ae5d9da38d480a501f5b563e2ae0d915c8a00a5.svg)

We will use the substitution method to solve the system. Notice that the first equation can easily be solved for $x\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}x+2y & =1 \\ x & =1-2y\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can substitute $x=1-2y$ into the second equation and then solve for $y\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}2x+y & =5 \\ 2(1-2y)+y & =5 \\ 2-4y+y & =5 \\ 2-3y & =5 \\ -3y & =3 \\ y & =-1\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, to find the value of $x,$ we substitute $y=-1$ back into $x=1-2y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =1-2y \\  & =1-2(-1) \\  & =1+2 \\  & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $x =3$ and $y =-1$, which can be expressed as $(3, -1).$
